item.description:
• Clean up after AI coding tools: old Claude Code, Claude app, Cursor Agent and Copilot builds, plus caches from Claude, Codex, Zed, opencode and ChatGPT. Sign-ins, settings and conversations always stay put
  • Gemini CLI sessions now show up for review
  • Scan any tool on its own, and rescan just the page you're on while keeping your other results
  • Find even more space: npx installs, pnpm caches and old stores, Xcode test clones and Organizer downloads, plus Deno, TypeScript and Docker build caches
  • Uninstall Xcode, iWork and other optional Apple apps
  • Safer cleaning: caches that Xcode, VS Code, Cursor or Codex are using are skipped, build folders with real work stay, and Mail, Keychains and iCloud data are never touched
  • The space freed count now reflects exactly what was removed, and scans keep moving even when a command line tool stops responding

• New Space Map: see your Home folder as a treemap, where bigger tiles take more space and colors show how long since you last touched them. Click a folder to dig in, right-click to reveal it in Finder
  • New Storage page: see used and available space for each disk at a glance
  • Derived Data is now found wherever Xcode keeps it, including custom locations and folders next to each project
  • Uninstall progress stays smooth while items move to the Trash and while you enter your password
  • A fresh blue app icon and a tidier Free Up Space button

• See live progress while cleaning a category: how many items are done, the one being removed, and how much space is freed so far
  • Items leave the list as soon as they're removed, and Stop finishes the current item and shows what was cleaned
  • Uninstalling an app now shows each step: quitting the app, moving files to the Trash, and waiting for your password
  • After cleaning, see what was freed and which items stayed behind, right on the category page

• Pick another app right after an uninstall to see it straight away, without pressing Done first
  • See a short summary when some items stay behind, with a Show Details button that lists each one, the reason, and a quick way to open it in Finder

• A new welcome tour shows how Smart Scan and the Uninstaller work
  • Set up Full Disk Access, the Show Cleana shortcut and launch at login in one place on first launch
  • Open the welcome tour again any time from Settings › General

• Scan and clean developer leftovers from Xcode, JavaScript, Rust, Go, Python, Java, Android, Flutter, .NET, PHP, Ruby and more
  • Clear old Claude Code and Codex sessions, editor caches and local AI model downloads
  • Uninstall apps together with their caches, preferences, containers and other files
  • Review every item with its size and last use, recent work stays unselected
  • Animated scan orb, keyboard shortcuts, launch at login and automatic updates
